memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys.” — Isaiah 41:18

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The Dead Sea never prayed. The salt never cried out. The barren waters never fasted. Yet God remembered His word.

Revival is never initiated by dead things, it is released by a living God who refuses to let death have the final voice. For generations, the Dead Sea preached hopelessness: “Nothing can live here.”
But heaven was silently saying, “Wait until the river arrives.”

Hear this clearly, Church: Deadness is not proof of God’s absence, it is proof that God is about to demonstrate His power.

When God releases His river, it does not negotiate with salt. It does not study barrenness. It simply flows and death retreats.

Many believers have learned to survive without life,
pray without fire, serve without tears, sing without the Spirit. But God is stirring again.

This is the hour when He says:
“I will not patch dryness, I will flood it.”
“I will not decorate graves, I will raise the dead.”

Revival does not make sense.
It does not ask permission.
It proves that God is still God.

Let the river come again. Let the Dead Sea moments of our lives become testimonies of divine interruption.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God never hurries. There are no deadlines against which He must work. Only to know this is to quiet our spirits.” A. W. Tozer.  When the time is full, the river will flow.

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let Your river interrupt our normalcy. Break our dryness, wash our altars, and awaken what we thought was dead. We ask not for comfort, but for life. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the river reach you unexpectedly. May life rise where death once ruled.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: “Revival God’s Way”

recommended_book.quote: “Revival is not a miracle in the sense of being something mysterious, but the result of the right use of the constituted means.” INSIGHT: When God’s people align rightly, the river is released, and even dead places respond.
